approved: The speaker introduced the Galilee Basin (Coal Prohibition) Bill 2019 to prohibit thermal coal mining in Queensland's Galilee Basin, including the Adani Carmichael mine and eight other planned mines, arguing that the basin would add over 700 million tonnes of CO2 per year and that Australia must keep coal in the ground to avert climate catastrophe.
